lines: As we entered Chaos Arena, we were greeted by the smell of burning flesh and a dreadful heat.
The arena was littered with the corpses of red-scaled monsters, and in the middle of everything Hebiko was desperately resisting having her body constricted.
H-Hebiko!!! Take this, Electric Jutsu: Spark!!!
The Salamander that was squeezing Hebiko turned this way at the pain of the flashy sparks and static electricity.
Shikanosuke's Ninja Art didn't have the strength to seriously wound someone, but at least it could get their attention. In that short momentー
Hotaru-senpai jumped into the pack of Salamanders and slashed through their scales.
Haah... haah... F-Fuma-chan... why are you here...?
We'll talk about the details later. Can you move?
And just as we started running towards the exit.
As the spotlight illuminated the walkway, we saw a masked beauty slowly walking towards us.
Snake Lady? So she's the owner of Chaos Arena.
Fuma-kun! That woman has a profound demonic presence. Please be careful.
Out of the frying pan and into the fire...
Snake Lady came and stopped in front of us with a clack of her high heels.
(I guess we're not gonna get out of here that easily...!)
